採用・広告の製品.quote: It is a next-generation operating system that you install on your physical spaces. It makes them intelligent and programmable. You can run apps and create prompts directly on your physical business.
Detect presence and movement from reflected radio signals. Useful for room occupancy and automation, without asking people to carry phones or tags.
UWB radar sends short radio pulses and measures the signals that bounce back. Movement changes those reflections, so software can detect that someone has entered a room or approached an area.

Use signal processing or machine learning to turn the measurements into events your app can use. For example, occupancy could control lighting or help a team see which meeting rooms need attention. The detail you can detect depends on sensor placement and the software model.
A button press can request help, while LEDs provide a clear response. Connect these interactions to your software to support everyday workflows, from checking in to changing settings automatically.
Make nearby places and objects recognizable to your app. Estimote BLE Beacons are small wireless transmitters designed for affordable proximity experiences and easy deployment at scale.

Redesigned around experience from millions of deployed devices, these beacons focus on simplicity and cost. They can run for multiple years, depending on the configuration. Choose Bluetooth when proximity is enough; use UWB when your application needs a more precise position.

Redesigned for scale, these tags use simpler components to keep large deployments affordable. They are a practical choice when you need to know that an asset is nearby and do not require the positioning precision of UWB.

Walk into a meeting room and find your call ready to start. Beacons let your app recognize the room, while radar detects occupancy. Connect these signals to SpaceTimeOS to welcome guests and prepare the space.

Make your physical operations fully digital, programmable and intelligent

SpaceTimeOS turns your physical space into a software-defined, programmable canvas. Create geofences, set up triggers, or write prompts that define what should happen when people or things move or interact.

Think of it as a computer game, but for real operations inside your business: you can see events as they happen and reprogram how your space responds. Watch KPIs on widgets or build automations that put location intelligence to work.

Use location data and rules to improve productivity and safety, or to delight your clients. You can also use SpaceTimeOS as a completely new source of rich data for your machine-learning model to help you create your own location intelligence.

Once you enter the room and the iPhone receives these settings, its UWB chip begins collecting time measurements from nearby anchors. Combined with the anchors’ true coordinates, those measurements let the phone calculate its precise indoor position.

A typical deployment delivers about 20–30 cm accuracy. Results depend on anchor count, placement, geometry, line of sight, and processing. A carefully designed cluster with additional filtering can improve both accuracy and stability.

規模・親会社.quote: UWB anchors are fixed devices that send radio signals from known locations. A compatible phone compares when those signals arrive to work out its own position inside the building.

The technique is called downlink time difference of arrival, or DL-TDoA. Signals from different anchors travel different distances. Their arrival times give the phone information it can use to calculate where it is.
